title: Choreo control map, version 1
description: control-map.yml: how each item in Information Security's review standard is met by a Choreo app. The assessor copies the app-scoped items into report.json's security section.

standard.description: Which copy of the standard the item numbers come from.

id.description: The item's number in the standard, which is its control ID in a report.

scope.description: app: its answer depends on the app, so it's in every report. process: met by the same pipeline step for every app, so it's recorded here only.

met_by.description: How the item is met, per hosting tier.

how.description: What meets it, in plain words, with where to look.

precedence.description: A Choreo decision that takes precedence over the standard's text for this item.

gap.description: What isn't built yet, so the item isn't fully met.
